title: Same-site browser API
responsibility: Create browser request helpers for the hub API using the existing same-origin session cookie.

inputs.name: browserApi.fetcher
inputs.description: Fetch implementation; defaults to the global fetch.

inputs.name: browserApi.failed
inputs.description: Callback for non-success HTTP responses; defaults to a no-op. Network failures do not call it.

outputs.name: browserApi
outputs.description: get/send return parsed JSON, bytes returns raw bytes, and media returns bounded bytes plus Content-Type. Calls require /api/ paths, omit empty query values, disable caching and use a 30-second abort signal. Writes send JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects non-API paths, coded HTTP failures, network/timeouts, invalid response JSON and media read failures. HTTP failures include status/code and readable wording.
